metadata.name: sofr_3m_quarterly
metadata.description: Synthetic CME-style 3M SOFR quarterly future on committed USD discount and forward curves.
metadata.source_detail: Finstack Quant canonical IR future calculation with explicit zero convexity adjustment The canonical typed market inputs are supplied with no calibration steps. Pricing tolerance contracts preserved. Re-baselined 2026-07-11 after the intentional switch from accrual-based MTM to exchange tick economics. The forward curve now carries the contractual 2026-06-19 to 2026-09-18 projection interval, so DF-chained term projection uses the reset-date forward instead of the legacy integral-average rate_period interpretation. Analytic derivation: linear interpolation at reset t=50/360 gives F=0.04+(0.041-0.04)*(50/90)=0.0405555555556; model price is 100*(1-F)=95.9444444444, and (model_price-95.8)/0.0025*6.25*10 contracts = 3611.11111111 NPV. A +1bp forward shift changes ten contracts by -250, giving DV01=-250.

plan.description: the canonical typed market inputs are supplied with no calibration steps. Routes through engine::calibrate without changing pricing math.

npv.tolerance_reason: Formula self-test: tolerance pinned to ~10x the worst observed deterministic FP residual (1.16e-10 abs / 2.8e-11 rel) for canonical pricing on synthetic inputs. Tightening from 1e-6 to 1e-9 catches drift introduced by refactors, FP-contract changes, or algorithm swaps that would otherwise be invisible at the looser band.
